malformed_edits.sentence: Operators procured spinning reserve, rather than non-spinning reserve.
malformed_edits.replacement: Spinning reserve is capacity that stays online and synchronized, ready to pick up load immediately; non-spinning reserve is offline capacity that must be started before it can respond. Operators chose the former because it can act within seconds of a trip.

malformed_edits.sentence: Those upgrades are planned on purpose, rather than by accident.
